_comment: Median wall-clock ceiling in seconds for recent successful runs on main, per workflow. check_ci_budget.py fails when a workflow's median exceeds its ceiling. Raise a number only with a reason in the commit body; the point of the file is that slowdown is a decision, not drift.

setup_step._comment: Ceiling in seconds for any one set-up step (a step whose name starts with one of the prefixes). The weekly check fails on a step whose median over the sampled push runs is over; each push's budget job warns on its own. Cut a slow step by eliminating, prebuilding or caching it; exempt a step only with the reason none of those can.

exempt.Pull ghcr.io/hacs/action:main: The runner pulls a Docker action's image before the job's first step, so no cache or prebuilt image can reach it; HACS runs beside the longer Python tests, never on the push's critical path.
